tasks.subject: Task 1: System-level Android NixOS module
acceptanceCriteria: File exists at exact path with content per plan Task 1 Step 1

tasks.subject: Task 2: User-level Android home-manager module
acceptanceCriteria: File exists at exact path with content per plan Task 2 Step 1

tasks.subject: Task 3: Wire modules into parent imports
acceptanceCriteria: nixos-rebuild dry-activate --flake .#syn exits 0 with no Android material

tasks.subject: Task 4: Set hendrik.android flag on lenovo-t14
acceptanceCriteria: Exactly one new line `hendrik.android = true;` after `hendrik.desktop = "gnome";`
nixos-rebuild dry-activate --flake .#syn exits 0 with no Android material

tasks.subject: Task 5: nixos-rebuild switch to land changes
tasks.verifyCommand: sudo nixos-rebuild switch --flake .#lenovo && lsmod | grep -E 'kvm_intel|tun' && ls -l /dev/kvm
acceptanceCriteria: KVM kernel module loaded after switch
/dev/kvm exists with group kvm and mode 0660
tasks.notes: First build can take 10-30 minutes — Android SDK/NDK/Studio/system image are all built from nixpkgs. Do not cancel.

tasks.subject: Task 6: System-level smoke tests post-switch
tasks.verifyCommand: newgrp kvm -c 'lsmod | grep kvm_intel; ls -l /dev/kvm; groups; qemu-system-x86_64 --version | head -1; systemctl is-active libvirtd' | tee /tmp/android-verify/system.txt
acceptanceCriteria: AC2: /dev/kvm has group kvm and mode 0660

tasks.subject: Task 7: User-level env + AVD helper smoke
tasks.verifyCommand: exec fish -l -c '<full smoke block per plan Task 7>' | tee /tmp/android-verify/user.txt
acceptanceCriteria: UB3: SDK layout has cmdline-tools, platforms, build-tools, ndk, system-images, emulator
UB4: adb version reports a version
UB9: avdmanager list avd shows smoketest

tasks.subject: Task 8: Emulator + assembleDebug smoke
tasks.verifyCommand: exec bash -c '<full smoke block per plan Task 8>' | tee /tmp/android-verify/emulator.txt
acceptanceCriteria: EM1: adb devices shows emulator-5554 as device within 90s
EM5: gradle assembleDebug exits 0 (or deferred-with-reason if offline)
